== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スイッチよ、切れてしまえ！</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分のドロイド1体が、破壊、捕獲、または盗まれる時に使う。その効果をキャンセルする。ターンの終わりまでドロイドはこれらの効果の対象にならない。2：このターンの終わりまで “バイナリ” ドロイドのスイッチをオフにする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">そんな機能を持ち合わせぬR2に、あまりにごむたいな3POのお言葉…</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Oh, Switch Off]].

'''Lore''' — Such outrageous words from 3PO to R2, who has no such function.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. Use when one of your droids would be destroyed, captured, or stolen. Cancel that effect. Until the end of the turn, the droid is not a target of those effects. Until the end of this turn, switch off a “binary” droid.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The title ends with an exclamation. Lore is about 3PO’s outrageous words to R2, not the English grease line. Game text numbers two choices and says the droid is not a target of those effects.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-ohswitchoff-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Oh, Switch Off]].</ref>
